About atomAIse

A shared front door for multiphase-flow resources.

The field already produces valuable datasets, models and benchmark cases. The harder problem is often discovering them, understanding what they contain and deciding whether they can be reused.

Purpose

atomAIse is intended as community infrastructure: a searchable index that connects researchers to resources where they are already maintained. It does not take ownership of contributed work or require every dataset to move to one storage provider.

Scientific scope

The catalogue begins with sprays and atomisation, then extends to multiphase flows where shared data and computational methods can support comparison, validation and transferable machine learning.

What a useful catalogue must show

A link alone is not enough. Records should make the physical system, operating conditions, variables, data origin, formats, licence, citation and limitations intelligible. Benchmarks should state the task and evaluation protocol; models should state their expected inputs, outputs and domain of validity.

Development

The site is developed openly. Its catalogue is version-controlled so additions and corrections can be reviewed, attributed and recovered. Early releases will stay intentionally small while the metadata standard and contribution process are tested with the community.

Open, attributed and built for reuse.
